hook.name: OrbitHook
hook.description: A hub-and-spoke liquidity hook for the ORBIT token. Satellite pools (ORBIT/quote) use fully custom accounting: buys fill from a hook-held ORBIT reserve, sells draw from banked quote inventory, both priced via Core TWAP × external oracle with a spread earmarked for token burns. The Core pool (ORBIT/WETH) is passthrough-guarded by a TWAP deviation band and per-block notional cap.
